The structure of composition Mg2Si2Cu6 (reduced formula MgSi(Cu3)2) adopts tetragonal symmetry in space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements: Cu is surrounded by 6 Cu, 2 Mg, and 4 Si, while Mg and Si each coordinate to 12 Cu. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Cu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Cu- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
